claims.statement: The container image is a single-process python:3.12-slim build whose entrypoint execs one uvicorn process serving both the read-only API and the HTML dashboard on port 8080, running as non-root uid 10001.

The image installs the cluster, viz, rag, rag-semantic, and pptx extras and pre-downloads the fastembed BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 model so opt-in semantic RAG works offline, as a best-effort step that falls back to extractive at runtime if the download fails.
The Helm chart creates a ServiceAccount and a ClusterRole limited to get/list/watch verbs with no write verbs, bound via a ClusterRoleBinding, enforcing read-only access by construction.

The Deployment hardens the pod with runAsNonRoot, runAsUser 10001, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem true, all capabilities dropped, and a writable /tmp emptyDir, and defaults to extractive mode, clusterEnabled true, and namespace open5gs.
The Deployment uses a liveness probe on /healthz and a readiness probe on /readyz, and /readyz reflects the background graph build by returning ready once the reasoning flow is initialized.

release.sh builds and packages the agent (and optionally sidecar) images into dist/, and deploy-cobra.sh --with-llm starts the sidecar with the GGUF model mounted read-only on loopback and falls back to extractive deployment if the sidecar does not come up.
